#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string str;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();
    getline(cin, str);
    
    bool in_par = false, in_word = false;
    int word_cnt = 0, word_len = 0, max_len = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = str[i];
        if (in_word && (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')' || i == n - 1)) {
            in_word = false;
            if (!(c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
                word_len++;
            }
            if (in_par) {
                word_cnt++;
            } else if (word_len > max_len) {
                max_len = word_len;
            }
            if (c == '(') {
                in_par = true;
            }
            if (c == ')') {
                in_par = false;
            }
            word_len = 0;
        } else if (!in_word && !(c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
            in_word = true;
            word_len++;
            if (i == n - 1 && word_len > max_len) {
                max_len = word_len;
            }
        } else if (in_word) {
            word_len++;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            in_par = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            in_par = false;
        }
    }
    
    cout << max_len << " " << word_cnt << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
